# SmileTown Dentistry North Delta

> A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in North Delta and Surrey offering specialized care for children of all ages, from infants to teens, with expertise in orthodontics and special needs dentistry.

SmileTown Dentistry is a kid-friendly dental practice led by Dr. Diya Chadha and Dr. Sukrit Grewal, specializing in pediatric dental care, early orthodontic intervention, and family dentistry. The practice serves the North Delta, Surrey, and surrounding communities with advanced treatments including Invisalign First, sedation options, and specialized care for children with special needs.
